 The Mizoram Board has released the timetable for Class 10 and Class 12 board exams 2027. Students can now visit the official website, mbse.edu.in, to check and download their schedules
 Mizoram Board HSLC, HSSLC timetable 2027
 Princess Sonika New Delhi 3 min read Last Updated : Nov 11 2026 | 1:46 PM IST Listen to This Article
 The Mizoram Board of School Education (MBSE) has released the timetable for the upcoming 2027 High School Leaving Certificate (HSLC) and Higher Secondary School Leaving Certificate (HSSLC) exams. Class 10 and Class 12 board exam students can now head to the official website, mbse.edu.in, to access and download their detailed subject schedules. in, to access and download their detailed subject schedules.    According to the timeline, the Class 12 exams are set to commence on February 8, 2027, whereas the Class 10 exams will start on February 10, 2027. Both sets of examinations are scheduled to occur between 10 am and 1 pm.   How to download MBSE HSLC, HSSLC Timetable 2027?
 Go to the official website at mbse.edu.in.   Search for the examination section on the homepage.   Find for the HSLC or HSSLC examination routine 2027 link. Also Read

(Mizo/Hindi/Nepali)- February 12, 2026   Political Science, Public Administration, Business Studies, Physics- February 17, 2026   Education, Psychology, Chemistry, Accountancy- February 22, 2026   Geography, BiologyFebruary 26, 2026   History, Mathematics, Business Mathematics- March 3, 2026   Economics, Geology- March 8, 2026   Sociology- March 11, 2026   Computer Science (T), Home Science (T)- March 15, 2026.  MBSE HSLC Class 10 Timetable 2027
 MIL: Hindi, Manipuri, Mizo, Nepali, Bengali, Alternative English- February 10   Social Science- February 19   Science (Theory)- February 23   English- February 25   Mathematics- March 1   Home Science, Introductory Information Technology, Commercial Studies, Civics & Economics- March 4.      ALSO READ:  GATE 2027 correction window opens: Check important dates, fees and details About the MBSE practical exam dates 2027
 The board has published the schedule for practical exams for students in Class 10 and Class 12. For Class 10, practical exams for Home Science and Science are set for February 4, 2027, from 9 in the morning until 4 in the afternoon.    In Class 12, practical assessments in Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Computer Science, and Geography will occur on February 1, 2027. The exams for other subjects have been arranged for February 9, 2027.    Both sessions for the Class 12 practical exams will happen between 9 am and 4 pm.   ALSO READ:  CBSE board exams 2027: Class 10, 12 datesheet released, check key dates   More From This Section
